name: Old Lorek
description: An old fisherman with a salt-crusted beard sits near the edge of the docks, staring out toward the open sea. His small skiff rocks gently beside him.
dialogue: Old Lorek squints at you. "You look like the sort that doesn't scare easy." Ask him about [cave], [spirits], or [boat].
If you're here for work, there's plenty. If you're here for trouble, take it elsewhere.

keywords.cave: Found a cave along the coast. Low mouth. Smells wrong. I won't step inside—something in there ain't for men like me.
keywords.spirits: Call 'em spirits if you want. Whispers. Cold spots. The feeling of being watched.

boat.response: Aye… I could take you. But I'm not risking my hide for nothing. You want me to row you there… say the word.
